members.name: root-hosts

members.deliverable: Verified official URLs, response observations, search log, CLAIMS and EXPAND tails

members.name: locale-hosts
members.focus: Country and language variants of official TheFork domains and their robots/sitemaps
members.deliverable: Exhaustive localized endpoint table with direct fetch status, official citations, CLAIMS and EXPAND

members.name: search-index
members.focus: Search-engine discovery of official-domain robots/sitemap URLs, indexed XML names, cache/snippet leads
members.deliverable: At least 10 varied official-domain searches; discovered leads clearly marked unverified until fetched; CLAIMS and EXPAND

members.name: manager-help
members.focus: TheFork Manager and official help-center domains, robots/sitemap endpoints and likely sitemap conventions
members.deliverable: Verified Manager/help endpoints and directives with search-vs-fetch separation, CLAIMS and EXPAND

members.name: redirect-probes
members.focus: HTTP/HTTPS and www/apex redirect chains, status/header/content-type behavior for robots and sitemap candidates
members.deliverable: Direct probe matrix with exact URLs and final destinations/status; CLAIMS and EXPAND

members.name: counter-audit
members.focus: Skeptical audit for missed official domains, false positives, inaccessible endpoints, stale redirects, contradictory evidence
members.deliverable: Counter-search and evidence-quality audit, gaps/dead ends, CLAIMS and EXPAND
